findings.summary: Baseline isolation shipped fail-closed but UNVALIDATED: the whole mechanism rested on the unproven assumption that `claude --settings <disable-file>` actually unloads a USER-SCOPE-enabled plugin. If it did not, --isolation no-playbook could never produce a clean number (every run would trip the sink and go INVALID) and a different isolation approach would be needed.
findings.disposition: After tagging v1.37.0 and `claude plugin update` (deploying note_hook_fired), the D2.d live probe (scratchpad d2d_isolation_probe.sh) ran two real Sonnet sessions and PASSED both directions: vacuity (plugin enabled) fired 17 hook events into the sink; isolation (--settings disable) fired 0. This CONFIRMS --settings unloads a user-scope plugin AND the deployed hook writes the sink, so the effect-proof is no longer inert and --isolation no-playbook numbers are trustworthy. The deploy-gate integration_debt is marked PAID/VALIDATED (capabilities.json), to be removed at the next debt sweep. Recorded incorporated: the validation is an empirical live-probe run, not a suite_glob test (a subscription-model probe cannot run in CI).
